title: The 10 Cheapest New Trucks in America for 2026 (And the Traps Inside the Price)
description:
The average full-size pickup in America now sells for more than sixty-seven thousand dollars. But there are still new trucks you can buy for under thirty thousand. One of the cheapest full-size trucks on the list is no longer being built at all. Another gets cheaper when you choose the bigger bed. And a startup says it will undercut every one of them. These are the cheapest new trucks in America, and the traps hidden inside the low prices.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
